{"tool":"write","path":"reports/export.py","content":""""Reports CSV exporter. Implement export_csv to satisfy TASK.txt."""


def export_csv(rows, columns):
    """Export mappings in column order as RFC 4180 CSV, including the header.

    rows: iterable of mappings (one-shot generators supported).
    columns: ordered iterable of unique string column names (one-shot
        generators supported).

    Returns a str with comma delimiters, CRLF record endings, minimal quoting
    (fields containing commas, quotes, CR, or LF are quoted; embedded quotes
    are doubled). Missing fields and None values become empty strings; other
    values are converted with str(). Inputs are not mutated.

    Raises ValueError if columns contain duplicates or non-string names.
    """
    column_list = []
    seen = set()
    for column in columns:
        if not isinstance(column, str):
            raise ValueError("Column names must be strings: %r" % (column,))
        if column in seen:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate column name: %r" % (column,))
        seen.add(column)
        column_list.append(column)

    if not column_list:
        return ""

    def quote_field(value):
        text = "" if value is None else str(value)
        if any(ch in text for ch in (",", '"', "\r", "\n")):
            return '"' + text.replace('"', '""') + '"'
        return text

    lines = [",".join(quote_field(name) for name in column_list)]
    for row in rows:
        lines.append(
            ",".join(quote_field(row.get(name)) for name in column_list)
        )
    return "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n"
"}
